sources.note: Avid Pro Tools | HDX product page (opened): HDX card with two DigiLink ports (64 channels) and one DigiSerial port; no dimensions.

Pro Tools | HDX Getting Started guide (downloaded to a scratch folder outside the repo, text read): HDX PCIe card = 2 DigiLink Mini ports + 1 DigiSerial (8-pin mini-DIN), needs a full-length slot; installs in any qualified Mac/Windows workstation. No card or bracket dimensions, no workstation dimensions: the box is a role-based stand-in (see notes).
